articles.title: A fast-acting psychedelic shows promise for postpartum depression
articles.summary: A new clinical trial suggests that a single day of treatment with the inhaled psychedelic mebufotenin can rapidly relieve severe symptoms of postpartum depression, offering a potential alternative to daily medications.

articles.title: The psychological factors associated with acting on a conspiracy theory
articles.summary: New research suggests that believing a conspiracy theory doesn't always translate to real-world behavior. Instead, the likelihood of taking action is linked to how certain people are about their beliefs and how useful they find them.

articles.title: Interpretable Unsupervised Community Detection with LLM-Symbolized Structured Processes
articles.summary: arXiv:2608.06402v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Community detection is a fundamental task in graph analytics that aims to identify cohesive groups of entities with similar behaviors or interests. Classic objective-driven methods struggle with complex graph structures, while deep-learning approaches improve performance at the expense of interpretability and rely on labeled data and training. Large language models (LLMs), with strong reasoning capabilities and world knowledge, are promising for interpretable, label-free community detection. articles.title: Latent Fact-Checking: Detecting Misinformation through Activation Engineering
articles.summary: arXiv:2608.06417v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The proliferation of misinformation online has driven demand for scalable detection systems. articles.summary: arXiv:2608.06422v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Giving an LLM judge more compute does not necessarily make it check more requirements. articles.summary: arXiv:2608.06427v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative models can reproduce an observational distribution while encoding an incorrect causal structure. articles.title: How we react to anxiety could be just as important as the anxiety itself
articles.summary: A person’s rigid attempts to avoid anxious feelings might increase their likelihood of developing an anxiety disorder. New research suggests that learning to accept and adapt to psychological distress could be a key component in treating mental health conditions.

articles.title: New research finds women’s buttocks play a more stable role in male physical attraction than breasts
articles.summary: Recent research published in Evolutionary Psychology identifies four distinct subgroups of male physical attraction. The study suggests men rarely prioritize breasts in isolation, indicating that buttocks play a more primary role in shaping romantic preferences.

articles.title: Decreased sleep in adolescents is linked to lasting changes in how the brain communicates
articles.summary: A new study suggests that getting less sleep alters how regions of the developing brain communicate. By tracking adolescents over time and testing sleep-deprived adults, scientists found evidence that sleep loss directly reshapes brain network connectivity.

articles.title: Standard clinic schedules can create barriers for working patients in alcohol recovery
articles.summary: A new study reveals that regularly employed patients are more likely to drop out of outpatient alcohol treatment than those without steady jobs, suggesting standard clinic hours create hidden barriers to addiction recovery.

articles.title: Dating apps tend to encourage age similarity rather than diversity
articles.summary: Digital platforms give users access to a massive pool of potential matches. However, recent data suggests that rather than broadening dating horizons, these apps generally encourage individuals to select partners of similar ages.
